Intimidating Reminder.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KNIGHT TYRANT unit has shot.
Intimidating Reminder.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next Command phase: ▪ While a unit is suppressed, that unit’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls. UNIQUE: WAR DOGS HUNTING WARPACK WAR DOGS ROOT OUT PREY AND SOW RUINATION ON HIGH‑SPEED DETACHMENT RULES SCENTING FEAR The corrupted pilots of War Dog suits despise fear and cowardice in the foe almost as much as they revel in hunting such prey and betraying their hiding places. (Once per battle round, per army) In your Shooting phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 12" of a friendly WAR DOG unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range. This detachment has the WAR DOGS tag and cannot be taken with another WAR DOGS detachment. ENHANCEMENTS SOUL-SPOOR AUSPICATOR UPGRADE Those Huntsmen darkly blessed with a daemonic device sensitive to a worthy prey’s spirits are capable of killing shots at greater effective ranges. HUNTSMAN unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks have +6" R. SNARLING RIVALRY UPGRADE The greatest Executioners are expert long‑range killers. They viciously compete for tallies of slaughter and eagerly eviscerate dug‑in foes to prove their skill. EXECUTIONER unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER]. HUNTS

Pitiless Focus.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly KNIGHT TYRANT unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
Pitiless Focus.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

Rune-cursed Stronghold.when: Any phase, when a friendly KNIGHT TYRANT unit suffers a mortal wound.
Rune-cursed Stronghold.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

Beasthide Manifestation.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected 1CP its targets.
Beasthide Manifestation.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Beasthide Manifestation.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Contemptuous Volleys.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Chaos Knights unit from your army Falls Back.
Contemptuous Volleys.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Feral Arrogance.when: Any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to a Chaos Knights unit from your army.
Feral Arrogance.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.

Flush the Quarry.target: One Titanic Chaos Knights unit from your army and up to three friendly War Dog units within 6" of that Titanic Chaos Knights unit.
Flush the Quarry.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those War Dog units makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, its models can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, they can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

Goaded Beast.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Goaded Beast.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
Goaded Beast.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". Merciless Fusillade.when: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase. 1CP
Merciless Fusillade.target: One Titanic Chaos Knights unit from your army, and up to two friendly War Dog units, that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Merciless Fusillade.effect: Select one enemy unit that is an eligible target for each of those Chaos Knights units. Until the end of the phase, each time one of those Chaos Knights units is selected to shoot or fight, if that enemy unit is an eligible target, you can only select that enemy unit as the target for all of those attacks and those attacks have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Animalistic Rage.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a **WAR DOG** unit from your army that has not been **selected to attack** this phase is destroyed.
Animalistic Rage.target: That **WAR DOG** unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Animalistic Rage.effect: Before resolving your unit’s Deadly Demise ability, it can either shoot or fight. When doing so, it must target only the enemy unit that just destroyed it, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target. After it has done so and after any Consolidation moves have been made, resolve your unit’s Deadly Demise ability as normal.
Animalistic Rage.lore: Many War Dog pilots are bitter and twisted souls whose hearts are filled with animalistic rage, and they will vent that anger with their last dying gasp.

Cunning Hunter.when: Your Movement phase, just after a **WAR DOG** unit from your army Falls Back
Cunning Hunter.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Cunning Hunter.lore: This War Dog’s pilot knows when to feign flight or give ground, only to redouble their attack the moment their prey’s guard drops.

Hungry for Combat.target: Two or more **WAR DOG** units from your army within Engagement Range of the same enemy unit.
Hungry for Combat.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of those **WAR DOG** units. Until the end of the phase, models in those **WAR DOG** units can only target that enemy unit, but each time a model in one of those **WAR DOG** units makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Hungry for Combat.lore: Eager to get into battle, these War Dogs hope to win glory and prove their worth to peers and masters alike.

Insensate Bloodthirst.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly WAR DOG unit.
Insensate Bloodthirst.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+.

Leash of the Masters.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly WAR DOG unit has shot.
Leash of the Masters.effect: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

Stalking Focus.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly WAR DOG unit within range of an objective.
Stalking Focus.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have ‑1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked. Avenge the Masters!.effect: That enemy unit is marked until the end of the battle. ▪ Friendly DAMNED units’ attacks that target a marked unit have [LETHAL HITS].

ENHANCEMENTS  HUNTER’S HELM This infernal faceplate was forged by the cannibalistic Dark Magi of Ghanarkh. Affixed to a Chaos Knight, it infuses the steed with a carnivore’s ferocious hunger. Chaos Knights model only. You can re‑roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit. OCTAGRAM OF CONJURATION This Knight suit’s cockpit incorporates a summoning octagram that drags warp gheists into reality and sends them screaming out to bedevil rune‑marked prey. Knight Abominant model only. The bearer has the following ability: Octagram of Conjuration (Aura): While a friendly War Dog model is within 9” of this model, after that War Dog model has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle‑shock test. THRONE TYRANNICUS So dominant is the psychoneural signature of this Throne Mechanicum that it dominates even other scions and their steeds as they rule over War Dogs. Titanic Chaos Knights model only. In your Command phase, select one other Chaos Knights Character model within 9” of the bearer. If the bearer has one or more Aura abilities that affect friendly War Dog units, until the start of your next Command phase, the selected Chaos Knights Character model is affected by those Aura abilities as well. ASPECT OF THE BEAST Something predatory and monstrous from the depths of the Warp has possessed this Knight suit. Its terrifying presence spreads like a pall. Chaos Knights model only. At the start of your Command phase, select one Dread ability to be active for the bearer until the start of your next Command phase, in addition to the Dread abilities active for your army.

Dark Sacrifice.target: One friendly DAMNED unit (excluding ACCURSED CULTISTS units) within 9" of a friendly CHAOS KNIGHTS model.
Dark Sacrifice.effect: Select one CHAOS KNIGHTS model within 9" of your unit and roll D3+3: ▪ Your DAMNED unit suffers that number of mortal wounds. ▪ That CHAOS KNIGHTS model heals that number of wounds.

Corrupting Taint.when: Your Command phase, just after a **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** unit from your army makes a Malefic Surge.
Corrupting Taint.effect: Select one objective marker your unit is within range of that you control. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
Corrupting Taint.lore: The foul energies and unnatural influence of the Chaos Knights spread from them like sorcerous radiation, tainting all they touch.

Diabolic Bulwark.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Diabolic Bulwark.target: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Diabolic Bulwark.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
Diabolic Bulwark.lore: Ectoplasmic blood surges hot through glowing conduits as the Fallen Noble feeds power to their Knight suit’s supernaturally enhanced ion shield emitters.

Hellforged Construction.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Hellforged Construction.target: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Hellforged Construction.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Hellforged Construction.lore: Reinforced with warp-infused materials and warded through ritual blood sacrifice, these Chaos Knights can withstand unnatural levels of punishment.

Profane Symbiosis.target: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army that is not Empowered.
Profane Symbiosis.effect: Your unit makes a Malefic Surge.
Profane Symbiosis.lore: Some Fallen Nobles are conjoined, symbiotically or parasitically, with the hideous systems of their Chaos Knight. This allows them to channel more unholy energies, though not without risk.

Warp Vision.target: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Warp Vision.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the **[IGNORES COVER]** ability.
Warp Vision.lore: Supernatural sensors perceive the soul-spoor of their prey, or even stare forward through fate and time.

A Long Leash.target: One **ABHORRENT** model from your army and up to two friendly **WAR DOG** units.
A Long Leash.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, those **WAR DOG** units are treated as being within range of any Aura abilities your **ABHORRENT** unit has.
A Long Leash.lore: The neural connections between Fallen Nobles and doggedly loyal or fearful War.

Disdain for the Weak.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Disdain for the Weak.target: One **CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Disdain for the Weak.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks made by Battle-shocked models.
Disdain for the Weak.lore: Fallen Nobles sneer at the pathetic efforts of their foes, doubly so in the case of those who fear them.

Imperious Advance.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Imperious Advance.target: Up to two **WAR DOG** units from your army or one **TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit from your army.
Imperious Advance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but, unless it made a Charge move, cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed (the Super-heavy Walker ability does not apply while using this Stratagem).
Imperious Advance.lore: Employing piloting skill or brute force, Fallen Nobles can either manoeuvre or simply barge their steeds through foes and obstacles alike.
